LESSON: READING FOR INFORMATION: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading 2.3 Reading for Comprehension (2 sessions) • Reading pace • Comprehensio
Topic 2.8: Reading for Information: Visuals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading for Information: Visuals. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it good to make plans before carrying out an activity?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING FOR INFORMATION: VISUALS
This lesson teaches Reading for Information: Visuals for Grade 9 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading for Information: Visuals using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading for Information: Visuals above.
2. Explain Reading for Information: Visuals to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading for Information: Visuals.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading for Information: Visuals with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading for Information: Visuals important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it good to make plans before carrying out an activity?
2. How can we find the meaning of new words in a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
